technique: Enter Locust pose with steady footing and an even pelvis; lengthen the spine without forcing end range.
Distribute load through the feet or support points; soften the jaw and keep the neck long.
cues: Breathe steadily; ease out of the shape if sharp pain appears.
Use blocks or a strap to keep joints stacked and comfortable.
breathing: Inhale to lengthen; exhale to settle into the shape without collapsing.
safetyNotes: Move within a comfortable range; props are encouraged rather than forcing depth.
Stop and rest if you feel dizziness, numbness, or joint locking.
contraindicationNotes: General safety: seek clinician guidance for recent injury, uncontrolled hypertension, or acute illness before practising.
